datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 112.3 thousand buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 14% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 3 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 8% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from the OpenStreetMap database for North Macedonia by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset represents approximately 112.3 thousand mapped buildings with an average data age of 3 years, with 8% of features added or updated within the last 6 months. Data quality is estimated at approximately 14% coverage relative to AI-based total building estimates.
